questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction zones. Slow down and be careful when you see this sign. Construction work is beginning ahead.

questions.explanation: Chevron signs show the direction of a sharp curve ahead. The arrow points in the direction of the curve. You may see several of these signs along the curve.

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.

The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.

options.text: Signal before you go any further.

options.text: School is nearby or children are crossing.
